title: Visa Processing Tracker
outcome: An authorized operator can manage each confirmed traveller's visa case through an explicit lifecycle while the booking owner sees only truthful, customer-safe status and required actions.
actor: Authenticated booking owner and authorized Operator Operations Staff acting within the booking's operator scope.
modules: Visa owns visa cases, state transitions, customer-safe action, operator notes and append-oriented status history.
Traveller supplies stable traveller identifiers without duplicating identity or passport data.
Booking supplies confirmed booking ownership and operator scope.
Documents supplies document-readiness projection only; Visa does not read or expose private document content.
routes: Authorized operator workspace -> Visa processing queue
Visa case history -> Audited operational timeline
acceptance: One visa case exists per traveller on an eligible confirmed booking and remains scoped to its booking operator.
The lifecycle is NotStarted, AwaitingDocuments, ReadyToSubmit, Submitted, Processing and a terminal or actionable outcome of Approved, ActionRequired or Rejected.
Only authorized Operator Operations Staff can transition a case, and direct arbitrary status editing is rejected.
Every transition records previous state, new state, actor, timestamp, concurrency version and an operator reason where required.
Booking owners can view only account-owned bookings and receive safe not-found responses for foreign identifiers.
Customers see simplified truthful status, last-updated time and safe required action without internal notes, government references, document content or sensitive operational data.
Visa approval is recorded operator evidence, never inferred from document approval, payment, elapsed time or UI state.
Document readiness may permit ReadyToSubmit but never automatically submits, approves or rejects a visa case.
Stale concurrent transitions are rejected without losing history.
Loading, empty, unavailable, permission-denied, stale, action-required, rejected, approved and recoverable-error states are complete.
Customer and operator surfaces preserve NoorPath visual language and pass keyboard, focus, target-size, reflow, reduced-motion and WCAG checks.
Telemetry records safe transition outcomes, queue latency and projection failures without traveller identity, passport or visa-reference data.
exclusions: Government, embassy, consulate or external visa-provider API integration.
Automated submission, approval, rejection, eligibility scoring or legal advice.
Uploading or duplicating passport and visa evidence; private files remain Documents-owned.
Email, SMS, WhatsApp or push notifications; owned by VS-17.
Generic CRM, unrestricted admin editing or bulk status mutation.
